sloka: तम् दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे सिद्धाश्रम निवासिनः ।उत्पत्योत्पत्य सहसा विश्वामित्रम् अपूजयन् ॥१-२९-२६॥
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve siddhāśrama nivāsinaḥ ।utpatyotpatya sahasā viśvāmitram apūjayan ॥1-29-26॥

translations.english: At the sight of Viswamitra all the ascetics, inmates of Siddhashrama, jumped out instantly and offered him their worship.
